ai-assisted-documentation.label: AI-Assisted Documentation
ai-assisted-documentation.description: The use of artificial intelligence tools to assist in creating, reviewing, or transforming documentation.

api-authentication.label: API Authentication
api-authentication.description: Methods and protocols for authenticating API requests, such as OAuth, mTLS, and API keys.

api-documentation.label: API Documentation
api-documentation.description: Documentation that describes how to use an API, including endpoints, parameters, authentication, and examples.

architecture-diagrams.label: Architecture Diagrams
architecture-diagrams.description: Diagrams that represent the structure and relationships of a system's components.

automation.label: Automation
automation.description: The use of scripts and tools to automate repetitive documentation tasks, such as migration, validation, and publishing.

ci-cd.label: CI/CD
ci-cd.description: Continuous integration and continuous deployment practices applied to documentation builds and publishing.

conditional-text.label: Conditional Text
conditional-text.description: Content that is conditionally included or excluded based on target audience or output format.

content-inventory.label: Content Inventory
content-inventory.description: A systematic assessment of existing documentation content, often used for migration or restructuring.

content-management.label: Content Management
content-management.description: The process of creating, managing, and publishing digital content, often using a CMS.

content-migration.label: Content Migration
content-migration.description: The process of moving content from one platform or format to another.

content-reuse.label: Content Reuse
content-reuse.description: Reusing content across multiple documents or outputs to reduce duplication and maintain consistency.

developer-experience.label: Developer Experience
developer-experience.description: The overall experience of developers when using a product, API, or documentation, focusing on usability and efficiency.

developer-portal.label: Developer Portal
developer-portal.description: A website or platform that provides developers with documentation, tools, and resources for integrating with a product.

diagrams-as-code.label: Diagrams-as-Code
diagrams-as-code.description: The practice of creating diagrams from text-based source files, such as PlantUML or Mermaid, that can be version-controlled.

digital-signage.label: Digital Signage
digital-signage.description: The use of digital displays to show content, such as advertisements or information, often managed by a content management system.

docs-as-code.label: Docs-as-Code
docs-as-code.description: The practice of treating documentation like code, using version control, CI/CD, and automated builds.

documentation-governance.label: Documentation Governance
documentation-governance.description: The processes and standards for managing documentation quality, ownership, and lifecycle.

documentation-metrics.label: Documentation Metrics
documentation-metrics.description: Quantitative measures used to assess documentation usage, quality, and maintenance needs.

documentation-platform.label: Documentation Platform
documentation-platform.description: A system or toolset used to create, manage, and publish documentation.

documentation-quality.label: Documentation Quality
documentation-quality.description: The practice of ensuring documentation is accurate, clear, and consistent through review and automated checks.

documentation-strategy.label: Documentation Strategy
documentation-strategy.description: The high-level planning of documentation initiatives, including audience, structure, and tooling.

encryption.label: Encryption
encryption.description: The process of encoding data to protect it from unauthorized access, including field-level encryption and TLS.

information-architecture.label: Information Architecture
information-architecture.description: The structural design of information to support findability and usability.

integration-testing.label: Integration Testing
integration-testing.description: Testing that verifies the interaction between different systems or components.

learning-paths.label: Learning Paths
learning-paths.description: Structured sequences of documentation topics that guide users through a subject area.

markdown.label: Markdown
markdown.description: A lightweight markup language used for formatting text, commonly used in documentation.

openapi.label: OpenAPI
openapi.description: A specification for describing REST APIs, used for generating reference documentation and client SDKs.

payments.label: Payments
payments.description: The domain of financial transactions, including payment gateways, digital wallets, and tokenisation.

pci-dss.label: PCI DSS
pci-dss.description: The Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard, a set of security requirements for handling cardholder data.

rag.label: RAG
rag.description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation, a technique that combines retrieval of relevant documents with language generation.

release-management.label: Release Management
release-management.description: The process of planning, preparing, and coordinating software releases, including documentation.

sdk-documentation.label: SDK Documentation
sdk-documentation.description: Documentation that explains how to use a software development kit.

search-and-retrieval.label: Search and Retrieval
search-and-retrieval.description: The methods and technologies for making documentation searchable and retrievable, including RAG.

sequence-diagrams.label: Sequence Diagrams
sequence-diagrams.description: Diagrams that show the order of interactions between systems or components over time.

single-sourcing.label: Single-Sourcing
single-sourcing.description: Using one source of content to generate multiple outputs or audience-specific versions.

static-site-generators.label: Static Site Generators
static-site-generators.description: Tools that generate a static website from source files, such as Docusaurus or MkDocs.

technical-validation.label: Technical Validation
technical-validation.description: The practice of testing and verifying that documentation is accurate and that procedures work as described.

tokenisation.label: Tokenisation
tokenisation.description: The process of replacing sensitive data, such as card numbers, with a non-sensitive token.

version-control.label: Version Control
version-control.description: The management of changes to documents, typically using Git.

webhooks.label: Webhooks
webhooks.description: HTTP callbacks that notify a system about events, often used for asynchronous API integrations.
